## Assignment: Responsive Personal Dashboard UI

### Description

Briefly describe your implementation and the main features you added.

### Requirements Checklist

* [ ] Added a Sidebar Navigation.
* [ ] Added a Header Bar.
* [ ] Added a Main Analytics Grid.
* [ ] Added a Recent Activity Feed.
* [ ] Used CSS Flexbox to align header and navigation elements.
* [ ] Used responsive CSS Grid with `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...))` for dashboard cards.
* [ ] Tested the layout at a 375px viewport width without horizontal scrolling.
* [ ] Added at least one mobile responsive `@media` breakpoint.
* [ ] Defined CSS custom properties inside `:root` and used `var(--...)` for colors.
* [ ] Did not use external UI frameworks such as Bootstrap or Tailwind.

### Testing

* [ ] Checked the layout on desktop.
* [ ] Checked the layout on a mobile-sized viewport.
* [ ] Verified that the HTML and CSS files are linked correctly.

### Screenshots

Add screenshots of your dashboard on desktop and mobile, if available.

### Additional Notes

Mention any challenges, incomplete requirements, or implementation details reviewers should know about.
